lines: Kabhi kisi ko mukammal jahaan nahin milta.
couplets.en: No one is given a whole world.

lines: Kabhi kisi ko mukammal jahaan nahin milta.
Kahin zameen to kahin aasmaan nahin milta.
couplets.en: No one is given a whole world, for some are left without earth and others without sky.

lines: Jise bhi dekhiye, woh apne aap mein gum hai.
couplets.en: Everyone you look at is lost within themselves.

lines: Jise bhi dekhiye, woh apne aap mein gum hai.
Zubaan mili hai magar ham-zubaan nahin milta.
couplets.en: Everyone is lost within themselves, and though we have words, we find no one who speaks our language.

lines: Zubaan mili hai magar ham-zubaan nahin milta.
couplets.en: We have words, yet find no one who speaks our language.

lines: Kabhi kisi ko mukammal jahaan nahin milta.
couplets.en: No one is given a whole world.

lines: Bujha saka hai bhala kaun waqt ke shole?
couplets.en: Who has ever put out the flames of time?

lines: Bujha saka hai bhala kaun waqt ke shole?
Yeh kaisi aag hai jis mein dhuaan nahin milta?
couplets.en: Who has ever put out the flames of time, and what kind of fire burns without smoke?

lines: Kabhi kisi ko mukammal jahaan nahin milta.

lines: Tere jahaan mein aisa nahin ke pyaar na ho.
couplets.en: There is love in your world.

lines: Jahaan umeed ho is ki, wahaan nahin milta.
couplets.en: Love is missing where we hope to find it.
